strictGate.reason: The current environment does not contain the npm docx package required to generate the complete DOCX bank. v11 remains the last strict-SSIM stable release.

changes: OCR Word output no longer emits unspaced per-word Word runs that can collapse spaces.
OCR line-level visual feedback for color/bold/italic is no longer overwritten by default per-word run styles.
Dense OCR raster cleanup now uses connected-component classification instead of a blind rectangular erase path.
Low-confidence size outliers are preserved as raster graphics when they are likely logos, stamps, signatures, or graphical fragments.
Protected raster lines are excluded from editable OCR text and calibration when a graphics layer is present.
Headless benchmark OCR now carries word-level styledRuns to mirror runtime input more faithfully.
Vertical table-rule detection is tightened so narrow I/l-like glyph strokes are erased instead of being mistaken for borders, while full-height table borders remain protected.

representativeRasterProxy.description: Residual raster-ink proxy inside non-protected OCR line regions after removing long structural lines. This is not SSIM.
